title: In-app order notifications with user preferences
intent: Customers see order updates in their in-app inbox within seconds and can switch off the ones they don't want.
problem_statement: Build a notification service that ingests order lifecycle events (order_shipped, order_delivered, order_cancelled) from the order system, idempotently by event_id, and delivers a notification to the user's in-app inbox unless the user has opted out of that event type. Users list their notifications (optionally unread only), mark them read, and manage per-channel, per-event-type preferences. Delivery goes through a channel abstraction so email can be added next quarter without API changes.

acceptance_criteria.text: POST /api/v1/events accepts order_shipped, order_delivered and order_cancelled events and returns 202 with the channels delivered to; other types return 422.
The same event_id is processed at most once per successful delivery (duplicates return duplicate=true and create nothing).
GET /api/v1/users/{user_id}/notifications lists the user's notifications newest first, with ?unread=true filtering; users never see others' notifications.
POST /api/v1/users/{user_id}/notifications/{id}/read marks one read; 404 for unknown ids or another user's notification.
GET/PUT /api/v1/users/{user_id}/preferences read and change per-event-type opt-ins for in_app (default all on; partial updates keep other values); opted-out events are not delivered.
A failing channel does not block other channels; if all fail the API returns 503 and the event can be retried.
A notification is in the inbox within 2 s p95 of ingestion (synchronous in-app delivery).

non_functional: Latency: visible in the inbox within 2 s p95 of the event
Channel abstraction: adding email must not change the API
out_of_scope: Email, SMS and push delivery (next quarter)
Persistent storage (v1 is single-instance, in memory)

ambiguities.question: How fine-grained is control: global mute, per event type, per channel?
ambiguities.assumption: Per channel, per event type; everything on by default.

ambiguities.question: Can the producer send the same event twice?
ambiguities.why_it_matters: Without idempotency users get duplicate notifications.
ambiguities.assumption: Yes; ingestion is idempotent by event_id.

assumptions: Q1 answered: order_shipped, order_delivered, order_cancelled from the order system
Q2 answered: in-app only for v1; email next quarter without API change
Q3 answered: visible within 2 s p95
Q4 default accepted: per channel, per event type, all on by default
Q5 default accepted: idempotent by event_id
